text:
sam_support: Customer reported org went to 0 tokens mid-cycle, then UI showed a promo top-up but API still returning 429s. They said it happened during a large demo and they have screenshots.

mia_support: Can you paste the org id and one example request id/timestamp? need to repro with matching headers.

sam_support: Org: org_8X7Y, example request id: req_rJ4q8, happened ~2024-11-20T15:04:12Z. Customer says UI shows +500 promo credits at 15:05 but API 429 continues.

nate_infra: thanks — sending a quick check to quota service. can someone drop the raw 429 payload they got? want to verify which limiter triggered it (global vs monthly).

sam_support: pasted from customer: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exhausted",
  "quota_type": "monthly_tokens",
  "available": 0,
  "retry_after": 3600
}
```

mia_support: UI showing promo credits often comes from `billing` view — but we had a recent change where promo buckets were rendered in the dashboard before being attached to the rate-limiter. we should check whether promo credits were materialized into the rate-limit store. nate, any traces for org_8X7Y around 15:05?

nate_infra: Looking at quota-sync logs: I see a `promo_apply` event for org_8X7Y at 2024-11-20T15:05:02Z, id promo_22, but the sync job that writes to redis rate-limiter failed (timeout) and retried at 15:10. so dashboard read (from billing DB) returned +500 immediately but rate-limiter still had 0 until the retry.

david_billing: This explains the observed behavior. The UI reads the billing ledger (optimistic), while the API relies on the rate-limiter cache. We have a gap window if the write to the limiter fails. Need to confirm how often this happens.

sam_support: Customer's ask: they want an SLA-friendly explanation for the demo they lost. can we offer a rollback or temporary credit while we fix?

mia_support: Offer an immediate one-off credit and escalate to billing for reimbursement. Also open an infra incident — this looks like retry/backoff logic didn't surface to ops.

credits-bot: auto-note: Created support-credit case SC-2024-349 for org_8X7Y. Pending manual approval.

nate_infra: Action items: (1) add stronger transactional step when applying promo so dashboard and rate-limiter update atomically (or flag/promote eventual consistency clearly in UI); (2) add alert if promo_apply succeeds in billing DB but rate-limiter write fails > 1m; (3) run audit to find other promo_apply events with no limiter write. I'll file infra task.

david_billing: I'll process the one-off credit for the demo and leave a note on the invoice. Also adding a short blurb in billing docs about promo propagation delay.

sam_support: I'll communicate to the customer: explanation + temporary credit + ETA on infra fix.

mia_support: For internal notes — include the API sample and the 429 payload. If customer needs a post-mortem, we'll draft one once audit is complete.

nate_infra: Filed INF-1258: `promo->limiter atomicity` and created alert rule `promo_limiter_mismatch` on cartesian cluster.

sam_support: Closing thread after customer acks the one-off credit. :thumbsup:
